text: Heeferɓe ɓen e sirkuɓe ɓen seertaano, si wanaa ɓaawo nde hujja on ñiiɓirde e dow maɓɓe, nuleede Muhammadu (jom kisiyee) sabu bewre e tooñd. Si wanaano sabu fii Allah anndiino wonnde O nennanayɓe lepte ɗen haa e happu mo O anndi; woni Ñalnde Darngal, ko pellet, O ñaawayno hakkunde maɓɓe; O jippinira lepte ɗen e maɓɓe, sabu yeddugol ɓe ngol Allah, fenna Nulaaɗo Makko on. Pellet, Alyahuuda roninaaɓe Tawreeta ɓen, e Annasaara roninaaɓe Linjiila ɓen ɓaawo ɓeya, e kala arnooɓe ɓaawo sirkooɓe ɓen, fow e maɓɓe no sikkitii ndee Alqur'aanaare, nde Muhammadu ardi e mun, fennuɓe mo.
